caption: The drawing depicts a woman in profile view, facing left, dressed in a long, dark blue gown with a wide, bell-shaped skirt. The dress features white or pale fur trim along the bottom hem, at the sleeve cuffs, and around the high collar. The lower sleeves flare out and are adorned with intricate white lace. She is wearing light-colored gloves, and her blonde hair is styled smoothly and close to the head, with waves and braids. The background is a plain off-white color, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Edith Towner," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Felicia"
